updateMessage: CineVault 3.2.0 Studio Edition is a mandatory upgrade featuring enforced Family Safe Mode controls, fresh 2024+ live trending Hero Banners, universal search, and smooth landscape playback.
changelog: Family Mode Setting: Hides all 18+/19+ mature content when ON and unlocks the full catalog when OFF
Fresh Live Hero Banners prioritizing latest 2024+ & trending releases
Universal related Search showing all matching movies, series, and channels
Instant responsive Landscape Mode lock and smoother hardware-accelerated video controls
Restored quick-access Telegram community shortcut in the top header
